hero.name: Mohamed Dhia BEN HMIDA
hero.title: Software Development Engineer
hero.summary: Software engineer with 7 years of experience designing mission-critical systems for the financial sector. Specialized in Java/Spring Boot and Oracle SQL/PL-SQL, with expertise in Python/FastAPI and React.

highlights: Designed and developed robust software solutions for financial institutions, aligning with industry standards and specifications

Accounting centralizer for BIAT: integration and synchronization with the bank's information systems (core banking and other flows) via the accounting centralizer; orchestration of accounting and transactional flows; integrity and traceability controls; performance optimization (latency, volume)

Regulatory application for banks in the UEMOA region: design and integration of a prudential reporting solution compliant with BCEAO/UEMOA requirements (collection, normalization, controls, generation, and transmission of reports)
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to analyze requirements, architect scalable solutions, and solve complex technical problems throughout the development lifecycle
Implemented and optimized high-performance Oracle databases, focusing on data integrity and security to support critical transactions
Developed custom features, including reports, automated workflows, and user access controls tailored to each client's unique needs
Wrote comprehensive technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, API references, and user manuals
Led the analysis and detailed specification of client requirements to ensure delivery of high-impact solutions
Architected and developed advanced internal software for objective calibration of torque converters for automatic transmission, leveraging vehicle dynamics with Excel VBA as the foundation
Designed and implemented a comprehensive benchmarking tool automatically generating detailed reports according to complex client-defined criteria

Engineered a robust Excel/Access platform for data navigation, visualization, and updating, with external XML import/export and seamless synchronization via optimized SQL queries; later migrated to PostgreSQL while ensuring backward compatibility

items.name: DermaDetectAI
items.description: A sophisticated, multi-stage AI diagnostic tool for skin condition analysis. Features a Vision Transformer (ViT) for feature extraction and custom-trained MLP classifier for accurate predictions. Built with Python FastAPI backend and React TypeScript frontend, featuring real-time MedGemma-based conversational AI for interactive diagnosis.
features: Multi-Stage AI Pipeline: Vision Transformer (ViT) + MLP Classifier for accurate skin condition detection
Conversational AI Diagnosis: MedGemma-powered interactive analysis with context-aware responses
Role-Based Access Control: Comprehensive RBAC system with Admin, Doctor, and Super Admin roles
Real-time GPU-Accelerated Inference: Optimized for fast predictions with CUDA support
Comprehensive Dashboards: Patient management, session tracking, and analytics
PWA Support: Installable progressive web application with offline capabilities
Separate Training Repository: Dedicated AI/ML training pipelines with Git LFS for model management

items.name: CADSHIP - 3D Model Marketplace Platform
items.description: A comprehensive full-stack marketplace platform for sharing, buying, and selling 3D CAD models. Features advanced 3D visualization with support for multiple CAD formats, real-time collaboration capabilities, and a complete e-commerce system. Built with modern web technologies including React Three Fiber for high-performance 3D rendering and OpenCASCADE.js WASM for CAD file processing.
features: Advanced 3D Visualization: UnifiedModelViewer with Three.js supporting STEP, STL, OBJ, FBX, GLTF, and GLB formats with real-time rendering, camera controls, and fullscreen mode
Marketplace Features: Complete e-commerce system with model upload/download, pricing and licensing options, purchase history, and seller dashboards
Real-Time Collaboration: WebRTC-based model sharing, Socket.io for live updates, workspace management, and team collaboration features
User Management: JWT authentication with Passport.js, OAuth social login integration, user profiles with avatars, and email verification
Interactive Model Viewer: Camera controls panel, standard views (front, back, top, bottom, left, right), model hierarchy navigation, and screenshot capabilities
Content Management: Model versioning and history, categories and tagging system, search and discovery, ratings and reviews system
Analytics Dashboard: User activity tracking, download and view statistics, seller performance metrics, and content moderation tools
File Processing: OpenCASCADE.js WASM integration for CAD format conversion, GridFS for large file storage, and thumbnail generation
Performance Optimization: Redis caching for improved response times, rate limiting for API protection, and compression middleware

items.name: SkinSmart - Intelligent Skincare Recommendation System
items.description: An interactive web application that provides personalized skincare product recommendations through an intelligent survey system. Features real-time skin analysis using webcam capture, dynamic question flow based on user responses, and integrated e-commerce functionality. Built with React, TypeScript, and PHP backend with MySQL database.
features: Interactive Survey System: Dynamic question flow with conditional branching based on user responses, progress tracking with stepper UI, and question history navigation
Real-Time Skin Analysis: Webcam integration for facial image capture, client-side face detection using TensorFlow.js, and automated skin condition assessment
Intelligent Recommendation Engine: Personalized product recommendations based on survey responses and skin analysis, diagnosis mapping system linking skin conditions to appropriate products
E-Commerce Integration: Shopping cart functionality with order management, product catalog with categories and pricing, order confirmation with email notifications via PHPMailer
Admin Dashboard: Product management (CRUD operations), diagnosis and question management, order tracking and analytics, A/B testing framework for optimization
Analytics & Tracking: User behavior heatmap visualization, conversion funnel analysis, A/B testing service for feature optimization, comprehensive analytics dashboard
Database Architecture: MySQL backend with normalized schema, support for products, diagnoses, orders, questions, and recommendations, RESTful PHP API with proper error handling
User Experience: Material-UI components with responsive design, loading states and error boundaries, progressive image loading for performance, export and share functionality for results
Authentication & Security: Protected admin routes with JWT authentication, CORS configuration for API security, input validation and sanitization

items.name: VisionForge AI - Centralized Computer Vision Framework
items.description: An extensible computer vision training and deployment platform with real-time quality validation. Framework-first architecture designed for any CV classification task, demonstrated through a dermatological analysis application. Features complete MLOps workflow from dataset management to model deployment with multi-model ensemble capabilities.
features: Multi-Model Training Pipeline: Support for EfficientNet, ConvNext, and Vision Transformers with configurable hyperparameters (epochs, batch size, learning rate, optimizer)
Real-Time Quality Validation: MediaPipe-powered face detection with 468 3D landmarks, live feedback for lighting, blur, pose, distance, and stability
Complete MLOps Platform: Custom dataset upload and management, real-time training metrics tracking, model versioning and deployment system
Admin Dashboard: Comprehensive control panel for model management, training job monitoring, and dataset organization
Region-Based Analysis: Multi-region segmentation (forehead, cheeks, nose, chin, eye areas) with heatmap generation
Modular Architecture: Hybrid Spring Boot + Python FastAPI microservices, easily adaptable to different domains (medical, industrial, retail)
IEEE Standards Compliance: Adherence to IEEE 2801-2020 (Biometric Data Quality), IEEE 7010-2020 (Autonomous Systems), IEEE 2410-2019 (Biometric Protocol)
Reference Implementation: Dermatological analysis application showcasing framework capabilities with three specialized models achieving 88-92% accuracy
NOTE: Open-source framework available on GitHub. Demonstrates extensible architecture for computer vision applications across multiple domains.

items.name: MDBH Portfolio

Built with cutting-edge web technologies featuring 3D graphics, smooth animations, and responsive design. Demonstrates full-stack development capabilities with emphasis on user experience and visual appeal.
features: Bilingual Support: Seamless English/French language switching with i18next, persisted across sessions
3D Visual Effects: Interactive 3D elements using React Three Fiber with floating geometric shapes, morphing animations, and mouse-following spheres
Glassmorphism Design: Modern UI with frosted glass effects, curved dividers, and gradient accents throughout
Smooth Animations: Framer Motion powered transitions, scroll-triggered animations, and micro-interactions
Asymmetric Hero Layout: Unique landing section with 3D profile presentation and rotating specialty text
Interactive Timeline: Professional experience displayed with 3D hover effects and glassmorphic cards
Hexagonal Skill Cards: Innovative skill presentation with custom SVG shapes and hover animations
Working Contact Form: EmailJS integration for direct email communication without backend
Fully Responsive: Mobile-first design with optimized layouts for all screen sizes
Performance Optimized: Code splitting, lazy loading, and efficient rendering for fast load times
